mandatory_future_disclosures.c10_stage_d: C10 n=15 and Stage D n=500 are reported separately and never pooled; historical C10 NO_GO_NOVELTY, FAIL_SPATIAL and BLOCKED remain unchanged.
mandatory_future_disclosures.qualitative: Examples are selected by preregistered rules for illustration only; every primary conclusion uses the full 500-image cohort.
mandatory_future_disclosures.stage_e: Stage E is post-D10 secondary descriptive analysis; valid-only summaries accompany expected, failed and NA counts and do not replace the Stage D primary decision.
